message.content:
This black-and-white editorial illustration features a magazine cover. Centrally positioned is a medium close-up portrait of a man in a military-style shirt with visible buttons and a collar. He has dark hair, dark eyes, and a neutral expression, looking directly forward. Behind him to the right, another man in a military uniform and cap is partially visible and out of focus.

The top of the cover features the bold, capitalized word "TEMPO" in black. Above this, a line of text reads "+ DRAMA PENGUSUNG SETYA NOVANTO". To the right of this text is a small, rectangular color insert of another magazine cover. The top right corner displays "6-12 OKTOBER 2014".

In the lower third, a black rectangle contains "EDISI KHUSUS" in white. Below this, large white capitalized text reads "BENNY MOERDANI" followed by "YANG BELUM TERUNGKAP" on a second line. The bottom left corner includes a barcode and price details: "00032 RP 35.000", "WWW.TEMPO.CO", "MAJALAH BERITA MINGGUAN", and "ISSN: 0126-4273". The background is a grainy, indistinct grey tone.
